title: security: RBAC v2 - enforce KMS region residency + audit logging hardening
author: Priya Natarajan
description:
Motivation: customers in regulated environments require deterministic KMS key residency and stronger audit trails when RBAC v2 policies are evaluated. This PR enforces region pinning for KMS-backed secrets, extends RBAC v2 policy constraints with residency checks, and hardens audit logging to include pre/post-evaluation context for sensitive operations.

What changed (high level):
- Add KMS region residency enforcement layer in the RBAC v2 policy evaluation path. Requests that reference a KMS key are validated against the resource's allowed regions and the customer's residency policy.
- Emit structured audit events before and after policy evaluation containing key id, resolved region, decision reason, and any fallback behavior. Sensitive fields are redacted per policy.
- Policy schema additions: optional "kms_region_constraints" block with allow/deny lists and residency mode (audit|enforce). Backwards compatible: default mode is "audit".
- Admin console API and CLI support for setting per-organization KMS residency policy. Includes migration path and warnings for orgs with mixed keys.
- Add unit/integration tests covering enforcement, audit payloads, and migration logic.
- Docs: update security and RBAC v2 docs with examples and migration notes.

Checklist: 
- [x] Add residency enforcement logic to RBAC v2 evaluator
- [x] Include structured audit logging (pre/post) with redaction rules
- [x] Add schema changes + migration hook + feature flag behind "rbac_v2_kms_residency"
- [x] Update admin API + CLI help text and docs
- [x] Tests and CI green
- [x] Security review by security team

Compatibility and rollout plan:
- Feature enabled behind feature flag; default is audit-only to avoid surprise enforcement.
- Migration job scans tenant KMS metadata and emits warnings for keys outside allowed regions.
- Rollout: start with internal tenants, then gradually flip to enforce for customers who opt in. Provide rollback path to audit-only if issues detected.

Notes for reviewers: pay attention to the redaction rules in audit/logger.go and the evaluation fast-path in rbac/v2/evaluator.go to ensure we do not leak key material or KMS ARNs. Performance: we added a cache for org->allowed-regions to avoid per-request network calls. See benchmark note in CI for latency changes (sub-ms under typical load).
